selection: VLC inside original 591 sections; >=90% reported ten-minute counts JJA2025; no selection by prediction error
model: original six-station IDW p=2, distance floor50m, minimum3 stations; no VITUclim fitting
comparators: uniform mean of original city-origin IDW field (manuscript definition)
